edges.description: MED17 loss of function disrupts Mediator-dependent transcription, producing postnatal progressive microcephaly with cerebral and cerebellar atrophy.
A postnatal neurodegenerative process produces declining head circumference and progressive microcephaly.
The neurodegenerative process produces profound psychomotor retardation.

nodes.description: MED17 is a subunit of the head module of the Mediator complex, required for RNA polymerase II preinitiation. The recurrent p.Leu371Pro variant is a loss-of-function allele (it inactivated the homologous yeast SRB4 gene in complementation assays), disrupting Mediator-dependent transcription. The resulting phenotype is a severe, postnatal-onset neurodegenerative process. MED17 belongs to the group of Mediator complex-associated disease genes.

evidence.reference_title: Infantile cerebral and cerebellar atrophy is associated with a mutation in the MED17 subunit of the transcription preinitiation mediator complex.
evidence.snippet: A corresponding mutation in the homologous S.cerevisiae gene SRB4 inactivated the protein, according to complementation assays.
